mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC >= -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between interaction signal and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth economic regime (GDPC1 annualized growth > 3.0%), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized, HOUST rises but SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between interaction signal and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a policy reversal that reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening regime with policy reversal
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, a decline in FEDFUNDS does not lead to significantly positive SPX 20-day forward returns (p>0.05).
